name: test-next
description: Builds the BUILT package inside a Next.js app. Prerendering executes the server component, so reaching for a browser global on any path the render touches fails the build; the client component is bundled by Next rather than resolved by Node, which covers specifiers the two treat differently. Scope: code the render actually executes — dead code is tree-shaken before it can throw. Build-only, so no credentials, network, or browser; behaviour under a real browser is covered by the Playwright suite in examples/apps/auth-sample.
